question: What comprehensive division of eightfold groups is sought to be fully known?
premises: The object of inquiry is a division of eight octads
The desire is to know it fully
The knowing is sought in an exhaustive manner
inference: The speaker seeks to fully and exhaustively understand the division of the eight octads.
uncertainties: anantathā may also suggest infinite extent rather than manner of knowing
plain_english: I wish to know fully and exhaustively the division of the eight octads.
